lines.zh: 我逆着水流游，鳍一直动。
lines.en: I swim against the current, fins always working.

lines.zh: 石头在水下把水切成几股。
lines.en: Stones split the current into several streams.

lines.zh: 我身上有斑点，像碎石子。
lines.en: I have speckles like bits of gravel.

lines.zh: 这条河从山上一直往下走。
lines.en: This river runs down from the mountains.

lines.zh: 我们三条并排，穿进水草。
lines.en: The three of us run abreast through the weeds.

lines.zh: 水冷了，我游得更快。
lines.en: The water has cooled; I swim faster.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底，避开急流。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed, dodging the swiftest flow.

lines.zh: 前面是段浅滩，水面发亮。
lines.en: A shallow rapid ahead; the surface glitters.

lines.zh: 我摆尾钻进石头缝。
lines.en: I flick my tail into a gap between stones.

lines.zh: 树根垂进水里，我绕过去。
lines.en: Roots hang in the water; I swim around them.

lines.zh: 河面漂着落叶，我顶着走。
lines.en: Leaves float by; I push through them.

lines.zh: 我从激流游到静水，换口气。
lines.en: I move from rapids to still water to rest.

lines.zh: 水里什么味道都有，很杂。
lines.en: The water carries many scents, all mixed.

lines.zh: 我沿着河走，河没有尽头。
lines.en: I follow the river; it has no end.

lines.zh: 我转头避开水面的浮叶。
lines.en: I turn aside from the leaf floating above.

lines.zh: 三条鱼散开，各自找石头。
lines.en: The three of us split, each to a stone.

lines.zh: 水底有沙，我蹭过去试试。
lines.en: Sandy bottom. I brush along it.

lines.zh: 我从桥影下游过，不出声。
lines.en: I pass under the bridge's shadow, quiet.

lines.zh: 我停在水草后，只动鳃。
lines.en: I rest behind the weeds, only my gills moving.

lines.zh: 河水的凉从鳞缝里进去。
lines.en: The river's cold seeps between my scales.

lines.zh: 我在等一只落水的飞虫。
lines.en: I wait for a fly to fall in.

lines.zh: 水面的光一直在晃。
lines.en: The light on the surface never stops shaking.

lines.zh: 河底有块平石头，我靠着。
lines.en: A flat stone on the bottom; I rest against it.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步。
lines.en: I hear footsteps on the bank.

lines.zh: 这条河上下游，我都游熟了。
lines.en: I know this river both upstream and down.

lines.zh: 落叶卡在石缝里，慢慢烂。
lines.en: Leaves lodge in the stones and slowly rot.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让水自己流过。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let the water pass.

lines.zh: 上游来的水带着泥土味。
lines.en: Water from upstream carries the smell of soil.

lines.zh: 水在流，我偏要停在石后。
lines.en: The water moves; I insist on staying behind this stone.

lines.zh: 这种水，哪里都有。
lines.en: This kind of water is found everywhere.

lines.zh: 我在数水面上的泡。
lines.en: I am counting bubbles on the surface.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见石头滚动。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear stones roll.

lines.zh: 你站在河岸上，往水里看。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, looking down.

lines.zh: 我游到你影子边上。
lines.en: I drift to the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在水里碎成几块。
lines.en: Your reflection breaks into pieces on the water.

lines.zh: 你手里那根杆，我见过很多次。
lines.en: I have seen that rod in your hands many times.

lines.zh: 你要钓我，还是只看？
lines.en: Are you fishing, or only watching?

lines.zh: 我抬头，嘴碰了一下水面。
lines.en: I look up and my mouth touches the surface.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水声大了些。
lines.en: You crouch; the water sounds louder.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探头看你。
lines.en: I poke my head from a gap in the stones.

lines.zh: 你的靴子已经湿了。
lines.en: Your boots are already wet.

lines.zh: 我兜了一圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: I circle once and return to where I was.

lines.zh: 我被砍中，水立刻红了。
lines.en: The blade lands and the water reddens at once.

lines.zh: 我翻白了半圈，又挣回来。
lines.en: I roll belly-up halfway, then right myself.

lines.zh: 疼得我撞上河底的石头。
lines.en: The pain drives me into a stone.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了两片，顺水漂走。
lines.en: Two scales come loose and drift away.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，鳃拼命动。
lines.en: I wedge into a crevice, gills pumping.

lines.zh: 血丝顺着急流往下游去。
lines.en: Threads of blood ride the rapids downstream.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我发懵。
lines.en: That blow leaves me stunned.

lines.zh: 我沉到底，装作一块石头。
lines.en: I sink and pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 你的手比水鸟的喙还准。
lines.en: Your hand is surer than a heron's beak.

lines.zh: 河里没有地方可以躲太久。
lines.en: There is nowhere in the river to hide for long.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面上一沉一浮。
lines.en: Something bobs and sinks on the surface.

lines.zh: 我闻到饵的味道，很腥。
lines.en: I smell bait; it is fishy.

lines.zh: 这味道不该出现在这里。
lines.en: This smell should not be in this river.

lines.zh: 我游近了半步，又退回来。
lines.en: I close half a step, then back away.

lines.zh: 河里的虫没这么香。
lines.en: The river's insects are never this fragrant.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，水先进来了。
lines.en: I open my mouth; water enters first.

lines.zh: 你抖了一下线，我就动。
lines.en: You twitch the line and I move.

lines.zh: 我盯着那团影子，忍不住。
lines.en: I stare at that shadow, unable to resist.

lines.zh: 就咬一口，我能挣脱。
lines.en: One bite only; I can break free.

lines.zh: 上游的水把我推过去了。
lines.en: The upstream current pushes me toward it.

lines.zh: 你的腿进水，水流乱了。
lines.en: Your leg enters and the current breaks.

lines.zh: 我被撞得撞上石头。
lines.en: The impact slams me against a stone.

lines.zh: 水花溅到岸上的草。
lines.en: Spray splashes the grass on the bank.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，赶紧正过来。
lines.en: I roll over and quickly right myself.

lines.zh: 你踩到河底，泥翻上来。
lines.en: You step on the bottom and silt rises.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，游进深水。
lines.en: I skirt around you into deeper water.

lines.zh: 这条河太窄，躲不开。
lines.en: This river is too narrow to dodge.

lines.zh: 你的靴子刮掉我两片鳞。
lines.en: Your boot scrapes off two of my scales.

lines.zh: 我被水流推着撞你。
lines.en: The current pushes me into you.

lines.zh: 等水静下来，我才动。
lines.en: I move only once the water settles.

lines.zh: 我要往上游去，那里水浅。
lines.en: I head upstream, where the water is shallow.

lines.zh: 河底的碎石是我清出来的。
lines.en: I cleared the gravel on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 它侧腹的黑点比我多两排。
lines.en: It has two more rows of dark spots than I do.

lines.zh: 我们并排逆流，谁也不让。
lines.en: We swim abreast against the current, neither yielding.

lines.zh: 水太急，卵会冲走。
lines.en: The current is too swift; eggs would wash away.

lines.zh: 我刨开碎石，挖了一个坑。
lines.en: I dig a hollow in the gravel.

lines.zh: 它守在下游，我守上游。
lines.en: It guards downstream; I guard upstream.

lines.zh: 别的鱼来，我们把它赶走。
lines.en: When other fish come, we drive them off.

lines.zh: 等水退了，卵才安全。
lines.en: The eggs are safe only when the water drops.

lines.zh: 我们三条里，只有我们成对。
lines.en: Among the three in this bend, only we are paired.

lines.zh: 我被提出水面，空气很硬。
lines.en: I am lifted out; the air feels hard.

lines.zh: 我在网里跳，鳞刮着网线。
lines.en: I thrash in the net; scales rasp the mesh.

lines.zh: 桶里的水没有河的味道。
lines.en: The bucket water does not smell of the river.

lines.zh: 你的手心比河水烫得多。
lines.en: Your palm is far hotter than river water.

lines.zh: 这水太静，我找不到流向。
lines.en: This water is too still; I find no current.

lines.zh: 我撞桶壁，想回河里去。
lines.en: I butt the bucket, wanting the river back.

lines.zh: 你要把我放到哪条河？
lines.en: Which river will you put me in?

lines.zh: 我记得来时的水声。
lines.en: I remember the sound of the water I came from.

lines.zh: 别摇晃，我头晕。
lines.en: Do not shake it; I am dizzy.

lines.zh: 我在桶底转，找石头。
lines.en: I circle the bucket bottom looking for stones.

lines.zh: 上游的水忽然变快了。
lines.en: The water upstream suddenly quickens.

lines.zh: 有东西踩进河里了。
lines.en: Something has stepped into the river.

lines.zh: 我转向水声来的方向。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound in the water.

lines.zh: 影子从岸上投下来。
lines.en: A shadow falls from the bank.

lines.zh: 不是落叶，落叶更轻。
lines.en: Not a leaf; leaves are lighter.

lines.zh: 我停下摆尾，让水流带我。
lines.en: I stop fanning and let the current carry me.

lines.zh: 河面被什么划开了。
lines.en: Something has cut the river's surface.

lines.zh: 我沉到石头后面，只露眼。
lines.en: I sink behind a stone, eyes only.

lines.zh: 这声音我听过，是靴子。
lines.en: I know this sound; it is boots.

lines.zh: 河只有两个方向，上都或下。
lines.en: A river has two ways: up or down.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and creep closer.

lines.zh: 它一动，水流就变。
lines.en: When it moves, the current changes.

lines.zh: 我借着急流，不费力气。
lines.en: I use the fast water and spend no strength.

lines.zh: 石头挡住了我半个身子。
lines.en: A stone hides half of me.

lines.zh: 我还差一尾就能碰到它。
lines.en: One tail-length and I can touch it.

lines.zh: 它要是往上，我就在下游等。
lines.en: If it goes up, I wait downstream.

lines.zh: 鳃盖开合得急，水声变响。
lines.en: My gill covers snap faster and the water grows loud.

lines.zh: 这条河我熟，它不熟。
lines.en: I know this river; it does not.

lines.zh: 我不叫，鱼不叫。
lines.en: I make no sound; fish do not call.

lines.zh: 等它再靠近石头一点。
lines.en: Wait until it comes nearer the stone.

lines.zh: 我撞它的腿，力量很小。
lines.en: I butt its leg with very little force.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的裤脚，被甩开。
lines.en: I bite its trouser leg and get shaken off.

lines.zh: 尾鳍拍水，溅它一脸。
lines.en: My tail slaps water into its face.

lines.zh: 这一下连鳞都没掉。
lines.en: That blow did not even cost a scale.

lines.zh: 我借着水流撞它。
lines.en: I use the current to ram it.

lines.zh: 它退一步，水就浑了。
lines.en: It steps back and the water muddies.

lines.zh: 我咬完就钻到石头下。
lines.en: After biting I dive under a stone.

lines.zh: 我的牙太小，咬不穿布。
lines.en: My teeth are too small to pierce cloth.

lines.zh: 在水里，我比它快。
lines.en: In the water I am faster than it.

lines.zh: 三条命的鱼，只能拼一下。
lines.en: A three-heart fish can only try once.

lines.zh: 我在河湾的静水里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the still water of a river bend.

lines.zh: 水从山上下来，很凉。
lines.en: The water comes down from the mountains, cold.

lines.zh: 河底的石头被冲得很圆。
lines.en: The stones on the bottom are worn round.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，试了试水流。
lines.en: I flick my tail and test the current.

lines.zh: 岸上有树，也有草。
lines.en: There are trees on the bank, and grass.

lines.zh: 水里飘着上游的味道。
lines.en: The water carries smells from upstream.

lines.zh: 三条鱼，各朝一个方向。
lines.en: Three fish, each facing a different way.

lines.zh: 这条河比我预想的宽。
lines.en: This river is wider than I expected.

lines.zh: 我先逆流游一段。
lines.en: First I swim upstream a stretch.

lines.zh: 哪里都有水，哪里都能活。
lines.en: Water is everywhere, so I can live anywhere.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，热气逼我下沉。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; the heat drives me down.

lines.zh: 离开水，我在石头上乱跳。
lines.en: Out of water, I thrash on the stones.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，却喘不上气。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把河水掀成两半。
lines.en: The blast splits the river in two.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，速度慢下来。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and slows.

lines.zh: 光透过水，照得我发白。
lines.en: Light pierces the water and bleaches me pale.

lines.zh: 河里的虫子越来越少。
lines.en: There are fewer and fewer insects in the river.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我浑身一震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and jolts through me.

lines.zh: 水在下面，我却一直往下。
lines.en: The water is above; still I keep falling.
